name: @matrixcharts/lite
description: Zero-dependency WebGL2 candlestick chart with a Canvas2D fallback and a sequenced live candle feed.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/write-dual-package-json.cjs && node --test tests/OHLCPyramid.test.cjs tests/Decorations.test.cjs tests/CandleFeed.test.cjs tests/FeedBoundary.test.cjs tests/StreamingIntegration.test.cjs tests/CandlestickLayout.test.cjs tests/Coordinates.test.cjs tests/Options.test.cjs tests/Panes.test.cjs tests/PaintSeam.test.cjs tests/PriceScale.test.cjs tests/SessionScale.test.cjs tests/SessionBreaks.test.cjs tests/TimeAxis.test.cjs tests/AxisLabels.test.cjs tests/CandleStyle.test.cjs tests/ViewBounds.test.cjs tests/ViewportApi.test.cjs tests/LiveEdge.test.cjs tests/Overlays.test.cjs tests/PublicApi.test.cjs tests/ChartContainer.test.cjs tests/HeadlessSeam.test.cjs tests/VerticalApi.test.cjs tests/IncrementalSlots.test.cjs tests/PointerClaim.test.cjs tests/IncrementalOverlay.test.cjs tests/DrawingOrderModel.test.cjs
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check:interaction && npm run verify:package
scripts.benchmark: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/write-dual-package-json.cjs && node benchmarks/sustained-feed.cjs
